workflows.name: Feishu Bitable project management tutorial
workflows.desc: A practical example of automating software project management with Feishu Bitable: agents can report bugs, scheduled runs can scan and analyze them, and sub-agents can be split out automatically.
workflows.goal: Automate and streamline long-running project-management work
workflows.requirement: A Feishu account and an application created in the Feishu Open Platform
workflows.output: Task records stored in Feishu Bitable and a bug analysis report

workflows.name: Tmall Supermarket product scraper tutorial
workflows.desc: Demonstrates how to scrape product information from a Tmall Supermarket category and automatically download product images.
workflows.goal: Automatically retrieve product information for a specified Tmall Supermarket search term
workflows.requirement: A Tmall Supermarket account for signing in
workflows.output: An Excel spreadsheet containing product information

workflows.name: Competitor price monitor
workflows.desc: Monitor competitor-site prices and send alerts when they change
workflows.goal: Notice a competitor price change as soon as it happens
workflows.requirement: A list of product URLs; a price selector where the markup is unusual
workflows.output: Alerts past the threshold, plus snapshots that keep the trend auditable

workflows.name: GitHub Issue analysis
workflows.desc: Analyze repository Issue trends and produce a weekly report
workflows.goal: See where the week’s problems cluster and which class is spiking
workflows.requirement: A list of repositories; a GitHub token with read access
workflows.output: A weekly report with opened/closed/stale counts and trend outliers

workflows.name: PDF batch extractor
workflows.desc: Extract structured data from multiple PDFs into Excel
workflows.goal: Turn a batch of fixed-layout documents into a table you can analyse
workflows.requirement: An input directory; a field template of keyword anchors and offsets
workflows.output: One Excel row per document, with failed validations flagged for review

workflows.name: Automatic email replies
workflows.desc: Automatically classify and reply to common emails based on rules
workflows.goal: Stop repetitive email questions from consuming human time
workflows.requirement: An intent-to-template mapping; sender domains cleared for auto-send
workflows.output: A sent reply or a draft awaiting review, with the decision recorded
